name: Tvameva Mata Cha Pita Tvameva
text:
त्वमेव माता च पिता त्वमेव
त्वमेव बन्धुश्च सखा त्वमेव ।
त्वमेव विद्या द्रविणं त्वमेव
त्वमेव सर्वं मम देव देव ॥
meaning: You are my mother and father, my family and friend, my knowledge and resources. You are everything to me.
purpose: A devotional expression of trust, connection and belonging.
supports: Remembering sources of support; easing loneliness; gratitude.
when: During reflection on support, belonging or trust.
